item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Lovely to see you. Here's your weather for Thursday, October 22. Thursday. Nearly there! Here in Shanghai, the day will be rather grey and cloudy. It will reach 21 degrees, and drop down to 14 degrees. Comfortable enough to forget about the weather altogether. Rain is very unlikely today. There are 9 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be sunny with a few showers, with a high of 22 degrees. This week we are thinking about getting dark early. Anything new today? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
